title: The
html_source: How’d he die, Bloom asked. Cancer, three years ago on Mona Island, says Nurse Callan, God bless him!

anchor.prefix: illing God's rightwiseness to withsay. She said that he had a fair sweet death through God His goodness with masspriest to be shriven, holy housel and sick men's oil to his limbs.
anchor.suffix: man then right earnest asked the nun of which death the dead man was died and the nun answered him and said that he was died in Mona Island through bellycrab three year agone come
